entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your order number to start?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 21st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's fine. I just don't want it. I tried to return it last week and your website was broken.
I see. I'm very sorry you experienced that. We did have a known issue around that time. So just to confirm, there's no defect with the band itself?
No. It works. I just don't like it. Your website error is the only reason I'm still calling.

I completely understand your frustration. Our whole system was down for about four hours, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Did you happen to get a screenshot of the error message when it happened?
No. I just know I couldn't print the label or even get to the returns page. I figured you'd know your own site was down.

No worries at all, the documented outage is proof enough. Let me just pull up the return policy for this item... okay. Looks like you're all set. The policy states a 90-day return window, and you're only on day 20. So, I can definitely process this return for you.

I've just approved the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just affix that to the box and drop it at a post office. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse processes it.
Whatever. I'll look for the email.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
